title: Fix Sketchpad TSX Syntax Errors
description: Fix syntax errors in multiple sketchpad TSX files that prevent the 3dm-ui from building. Affected files: Docs.tsx (line 776), Feedback.tsx (line 257), Home.tsx (line 555), Quality.tsx (line 698), Kit.tsx (line 1787), Design.tsx (line 10787), Type.tsx (line 1381), elements.tsx (line 211), Sketchpad.tsx (line 886). All errors indicate broken/truncated code where region markers appear mid-expression or mid-function.
summary: Fixed 147 unclosed JSDoc block comments across 8 sketchpad TSX files (elements.tsx, Docs.tsx, Home.tsx, Quality.tsx, Kit.tsx, Design.tsx, Type.tsx, Sketchpad.tsx) that caused parse errors in the vite dev server. The pattern was `/**` starting a JSDoc with `//` comment lines inside but no `**/` closing before code definitions. Fixed PlaceholderDiagramNode and PanelSectionWrapper in elements.tsx which had malformed JSDoc causing those exports to appear inside comments. Added MDX plugin (@mdx-js/rollup) to the 3dm-ui vite config to handle .mdx imports from @semio-tech/compose-js/sketchpad/Docs.tsx. The 3dm-ui vite build and dev server now start successfully.
